name: Ten final backend request and frontend interaction candidates
counting: Five distinct new measured candidates from each of two agents. A retained improvement or evidenced rejection counts once. Prototype tuning, correctness repairs, tests, builds, review, documentation and release administration count zero.

passes.candidate: Hoist the frozen native OAuth path-to-endpoint dispatch table
Fuse bounded native OAuth header validation into one scan
Scan Content-Length without intermediate list and integer-set allocations

Serialize composed public OAuth metadata once and reuse only immutable bytes

Skip a byte-identical recent-document storage publication.
Reuse only immutable serialized Wiki BFF failure descriptions.

reviews.scope: read-only frontend source, complete native compiler output and public native fixture review

findings.problem: Initial fused scan called key.lower before byte-budget rejection, allocating a lowercase copy of an oversized header key that baseline rejected before normalization.
findings.resolution: The retained scan rejects accumulated byte overflow before key.lower. Exact-limit, one-byte overflow,64KiB and1MiB header-name controls preserve native status/body/receive/provider outcomes. Six v3 paired process receipts succeed; final AST equals the measured qualified prototype.

independentReadOnlyReview.rootReadOnlyReview: All current source hashes and hashed fixture evidence are verified. The sole peer finding, oversized-header normalization before the byte bound, is resolved. The final native SDK metadata override retains the model with cached bytes; composition and retention costs are explicitly disclosed. No new inline exemptions or allowance growth.

reproduce: Follow fixture commands and source/artifact hashes in both scope records. Use the same locked dependency/tool versions and workload parameters in both arms.
Serialize paired local probes through /private/tmp/sarj-wiki-perf-round8-benchmark-guard.py; do not overlap benchmarks with builds or type checks.
Run unchanged make check with the pinned toolchain and explicitly enabled task-owned loopback PostgreSQL QA, bulk, cache, round7 read and provider databases.
limitations: Controlled local CPU, allocations and resource counts do not establish production page-load latency or an absolute optimization maximum.
Every candidate includes small and negative controls; rejected regressions remain in the scope reports. Repeated measurements and integration repairs count zero.
Authentication, session retirement, authorization, request bounds, privacy headers, mutable-input behavior and admitted-write ownership remain qualified under native entrypoint controls.

Frontend app inventories exclude shared framework assets and deferred chunks. The task-owned regenerable webpack cache was cleared for disk headroom after baseline capture; source snapshots, prior build chunks and raw evidence were retained.

Normal commit/pre-push hooks, hosted required checks, exact merged-tree deployment, authenticated production navigation and guarded original-workspace sync remain required after initial local qualification. Final receipts are separate to avoid self-referential commit identifiers.
